descriptionHtml:
A cute animated pumpkin that fills up as your stream goal progresses, built for Twitch streamers who want a Halloween-themed sub or donation tracker.

What You Get

  • PumpkinCode.zip, the StreamElements widget code
  • OneClickInstallation.pdf, a one-click install guide
  • ManuallySetupGoalWidgetTutorial.pdf, the manual setup guide

Works With

  • Twitch
  • OBS
  • Streamlabs
  • StreamElements

Setup

  1. Open the included code file for your service, StreamElements or Streamlabs
  2. Paste it into a new custom widget (StreamElements) or theme (Streamlabs)
  3. Add the widget as a Browser Source in OBS or Streamlabs
  4. Set your goal target and pick which events count toward it

Typical setup time: about 10 to 15 minutes, done manually through StreamElements or Streamlabs.

Customizable

  • Colour
  • Font
  • Font size

FAQ

What events count toward the goal?

Donations, followers, bit cheers and support events each add progress, set inside the StreamElements or Streamlabs widget editor.

Does this work with Streamlabs?

Yes, the download includes a Streamlabs-compatible version alongside the StreamElements code file. Add either as a Browser Source in OBS Studio or Streamlabs.

What can I customize?

Colour, font and font size, edited directly in the widget code before you upload it, no coding needed beyond pasting the file.

What do I receive after purchase?

A video walkthrough plus the widget code file and a written setup guide, delivered as an instant digital download.

  4. Leave any platform blank on the multistream widget to ignore it

Which widget in the kit reads chat from Kick, YouTube and TikTok?

Only the exclusive Spooky Multistream Chat Widget, not sold separately. The other two chat widgets and all five goal bars run on StreamElements and show whatever it is connected to, which is Twitch by default.

Do I need to buy or set up separate software for Kick, YouTube or TikTok?

No extra purchase. Kick needs your channel name and chatroom ID, YouTube needs a free YouTube Data API key, and TikTok uses the free TikFinity desktop app.

How many widgets are in this kit, and can I buy the multistream one alone?

Eight widgets total. The Spooky Multistream Chat Widget is exclusive to this kit and is not sold as a separate listing.

What software do I need to run this?

A free StreamElements account plus OBS Studio or Streamlabs. No paid software is required.
